Jewish entertainers defend Mark Ruffalo against antisemitism claims

A rabbinic group has accused Jewish entertainers of 'whitewashing antisemitism' in their defense of actor Mark Ruffalo. The accusations arose after Ruffalo commented on the Israel-Hamas conflict. Jane Fonda defended Ruffalo, stating that Larry Ellison should be ashamed. Other Jewish figures in Hollywood have also commented on the allegations.
